# DNYL — Official Portfolio, Projects & Digital Experience

> DNYL (https://dnyl.vercel.app/) is the official personal developer brand and interactive portfolio of Daniyal Hayat — Full-Stack Developer & Creative Builder specializing in high-performance React & TypeScript web platforms, native Android mobile applications in Kotlin, and Google Gemini AI systems.

## Brand & Identity
- **Official Brand Name:** DNYL
- **Founder & Developer:** Daniyal Hayat (`@DotDaniyal`)
- **Role:** Full-Stack Developer & Creative Builder
- **Official Website:** https://dnyl.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Profile:** https://github.com/DotDaniyal
- **Direct Email:** mailto:mdaniyalhayyat@gmail.com
- **Direct Phone:** tel:+923331001904
- **Location & Availability:** Pakistan · Available Globally & Remote

## Core Technical Stack
- **Frontend & Web Architecture:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Vite
- **Mobile Engineering:** Kotlin, Android SDK, Android Studio, Offline SQLite/Room Caching, Material UI, XML Layouts
- **AI & Backend Systems:** Google Gemini AI (`@google/genai`), Google AI Studio, Prompt Engineering, Grounded AI Pipelines, Node.js, Express, REST APIs

## Core Engineering Services
- **01 // Full-Stack Web Development:** Custom responsive web platforms, React/Next.js/TypeScript applications, and Vercel/Cloud deployments.
- **02 // Native Android Mobile Apps:** 100% Kotlin Android apps with offline database persistence and smooth touch ergonomics.
- **03 // Google AI Studio & AI App Engineering:** Custom Gemini AI applications, prompt engineering, structured JSON grounding, and secure Express API proxies.
- **04 // UI/UX Craft & Performance Audits:** High-contrast editorial interfaces, GPU-accelerated GSAP/Canvas motion, WCAG accessibility, and technical SEO.
